name: High Elf Cantrip
says: Know one wizard cantrip; Intelligence is the spellcasting ability for it.
does: The pick and the sheet entry work (open cantrip choice from the wizard list, outside the class's counts). But in combat the cantrip is cast with the first caster class's ability, attack bonus and DC (spellCasterNumbers/casterFor), not Intelligence: a high elf cleric casts it with Wisdom, and a high elf fighter or rogue with no casting class has no attack bonus or DC at all. Only a wizard (or other INT caster) is right. Not run against the database; read from code and a rules-package derive that shows empty Spellcasting for a high elf fighter and cleric WIS.
seen: sheet lists the cantrip; the spell card for a non-wizard shows the class's numbers or none
fix: Give the trait a granted_spell-style grant with ability int (GrantedAbility) so spellCasterNumbers uses the grant's attack bonus and DC for the chosen cantrip.

name: Infernal Legacy
says: Know thaumaturgy; at 3rd level cast hellish rebuke as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, at 5th darkness once per long rest, with Charisma.
does: Part applied: the Hellish Rebuke reaction offers the racial cast at level 3+ as a 2nd-level spell with a Charisma DC, spending the long-rest resource infernal_legacy (max 1). Thaumaturgy and the two spells are not put on the sheet by the trait (the player types them; they are allowed outside class limits and with no level gate, checked by test). Darkness has no trait cast path (it needs a slot) and no use counter: the single shared use at level 5 is spent only by Hellish Rebuke. No reminder for any of this.
seen: trait description only; a charges row for infernal_legacy
fix: Replace the note with granted_spell effects (thaumaturgy at will from level 1, hellish rebuke from_level 3 and darkness from_level 5, each with its own resource, ability cha) and a text_pt reminder.

name: Relentless Endurance
says: Dropped to 0 hp but not killed outright: drop to 1 hp instead, once per long rest.
does: Applied by the app on damage from an attack, spell or trap when the use is left and the overflow is less than the hp maximum (instant death excluded); spends the long-rest resource, logs it, and an undo gives the use back. A master's manual hp edit is not covered (RN-35 lists attack, spell, trap).
